In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of VDs on the efficacy of statin therapy is not clear and further studies are required to elucidate the effect.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
VD supplementation does not alter the lipid lowering efficacy of ST.
VD does not have a positive effect on the bioavailability of the statins and its efficacy in lowering the blood lipids.
VD supplementation may not be beneficial in the treatment of hypercholesterolemia and may be harmful in case of statin therapy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of VD and statins may not be a good idea for the patients who are on statin therapy for the management of hypercholesterolaemia.
concomitant use of VD along with ST does not produce additional benefit in terms of lipid lowering activity and may reduce its bioavailability.
VD supplementation along with ST is not recommended for lipid lowering.
